notes: 'nor' rests on the waw alone, the negation being gapped in the second member — rule 35's explicit provision for exactly that case.

'that did despite unto them' gives the relative to the article (rule 41), the head to the light verb's complement (rule 44), and 'unto' to the object marker (rule 16's first family), since that preposition exists only to attach the object to the verb.
'that are round about them' keeps the supplied relative frame with סְבִיבֹת under rule 46's recast-noun rider rather than marking it added.
